env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOWORK=off
env GOEXPERIMENT=

# A dependency with a wildcard replace followed by two exact-version
# pins of one module, all with local targets kept in the export, must
# rebase every directive into the ejected tree: the wildcard edit drops
# and re-adds the file's replace lines, so a pass over live pointers
# strands the pins at the source checkout.
cd lapp
logos run .
stdout '^dep-pinned2$'

logos eject -o $WORK/out
exists $WORK/out/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v1.0.0/go.mod
grep 'example.com/lib => ./../../../fallback$' $WORK/out/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v1.0.0/go.mod
grep 'example.com/lib v1.0.0 => ./../../../pinned1$' $WORK/out/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v1.0.0/go.mod
grep 'example.com/lib v1.1.0 => ./../../../pinned2$' $WORK/out/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v1.0.0/go.mod

# The pins must not reference the source checkout: remove it and build
# the ejected dependency standalone.
cd ..
rm lapp
! exists lapp
cd $WORK/out/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v1.0.0
go build ./...
go vet .

-- lapp/go.mod --
module example.com/wapp

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/dep v1.0.0
	example.com/lib v1.1.0
)

replace example.com/dep v1.0.0 => ./dep

replace example.com/lib => ./fallback

replace example.com/lib v1.0.0 => ./pinned1

replace example.com/lib v1.1.0 => ./pinned2

-- lapp/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/dep"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(dep.Msg())
}

-- lapp/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27

require example.com/lib v1.0.0

replace example.com/lib => ../fallback

replace example.com/lib v1.0.0 => ../pinned1

replace example.com/lib v1.1.0 => ../pinned2

-- lapp/dep/dep.go --
// Package dep exercises rebased replaces: its non-test code imports
// logos/sync so the eject plan keeps this module, while its lib
// import resolves through the rebased wildcard and pins.
package dep

import (
	"example.com/lib"
	"logos/sync"
)

// Msg names the selected lib copy through a locked value.
func Msg() string {
	var locked sync.Locked[string]
	locked.WithLock(func(value *string) {
		*value = "dep-" + lib.Which()
	})
	var got string
	locked.WithLock(func(value *string) {
		got = *value
	})
	return got
}

-- lapp/fallback/go.mod --
module example.com/lib

go 1.27

-- lapp/fallback/lib.go --
package lib

// Which names this copy of the library.
func Which() string {
	return "fallback"
}

-- lapp/pinned1/go.mod --
module example.com/lib

go 1.27

-- lapp/pinned1/lib.go --
package lib

// Which names this copy of the library.
func Which() string {
	return "pinned1"
}

-- lapp/pinned2/go.mod --
module example.com/lib

go 1.27

-- lapp/pinned2/lib.go --
package lib

// Which names this copy of the library.
func Which() string {
	return "pinned2"
}
